Superflash Jacket.name: Superflash Jacket
Superflash Jacket.description:
A supercharged @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_clothing.Item.y3Ij43Eg3b0tq16F]{Urban Flash Jacket}. As an action, anyone within 5m/yds that can see the jacket must make a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs} or suffer the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_critical-injuries-head.Item.qoegLCfpEOQifeZq]{Damaged Eye} critical injury for 1 minute.

Each activation requires a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_ammo.Item.MfuoJ69NL1FiP7B8]{Battery Pack} that is destroyed an unable to be recharged after use.
